definitions.explanation: The organ that receives food and begins digestion.

examples.japanese: {胃|い}の{薬|くすり}を{飲|の}みました。
{食|た}べすぎて{胃|い}が{重|おも}いです。
examples.english: I ate too much and my stomach feels heavy.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}から{胃|い}が{痛|いた}くて{何|なに}も{食|た}べられませんでした。
examples.english: My stomach hurt from the morning so I couldn't eat anything.

notes:
{胃|い} refers specifically to the stomach organ.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {胃|い}が{痛|いた}い (stomach hurts)
- {胃|い}の{調子|ちょうし} (stomach condition)
- {胃|い}に{優|やさ}しい (gentle on the stomach)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {胃腸|いちょう}: stomach and intestines, digestive system
- {胃|い}カメラ: gastroscope
- {胃|い}がん/{胃癌|いがん}: stomach cancer
- {胃薬|いぐすり}: stomach medicine

NOTE:
- {胃|い}: the organ (medical/anatomical)
- お{腹|なか}: belly, tummy (general/conversational)
